sentences.en: It causes quite a sensation when Nomo pitches a no-hitter.
sentences.zh: Nomori投出无安打比赛时引起了不小的轰动。

sentences.en: The wound itched intolerably and gave him a burning sensation.
sentences.zh: 伤口痒得他无法忍受，让他感觉火烧火燎的。

sentences.en: He says he has a compressed sensation in the chest.
sentences.zh: 他说他的胸部有种压迫感。

senses.zh: 感觉，知觉：sense；轰动事件：intense interest

mnemonic: 词根记忆：sens（感觉）+ation（表名词）→感觉
